summary: The diff implements most of the required features across REQ-14 through REQ-20. Backend changes add accessKey to Settings, setAccessKey/getAccessKey methods, renameAppEvent/deleteAppEvent methods, and a migration module. Frontend changes add the Access Key Management section in Admin Settings, Bulk Comments Generator in UserView, Append Symbol in AI Templates, Edit/Delete in Admin Live List, and a play/pause music button. However, several acceptance criteria have gaps worth noting.

missing_requirements.requirement: Access key validation must call the backend — do not validate client-side only
missing_requirements.reason: In UserView.tsx, key validation is done entirely client-side by comparing enteredKey with the value returned from useAccessKey() (which fetches and caches the key in the frontend). The build constraint explicitly states access key validation must call the backend, not be validated client-side only.

The migration module provides upgrade migration logic, but the truncated main.mo does not confirm that settings is declared as a stable variable. Without stable variable declarations, the value may not persist across upgrades.

missing_requirements.requirement: The play/pause music button must reuse the existing useBackgroundMusic hook per the build constraint
missing_requirements.reason: App.tsx defines a new local useBackgroundMusic function inline rather than importing a shared existing hook. The build constraint states the button must reuse the existing useBackgroundMusic hook.

hallucinated_features.description: A standalone migration module backend/migration.mo was added as a separate file
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request did not explicitly request a separate migration module file; it only required that the accessKey persists across canister upgrades. The implementation choice of a separate migration.mo was not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: generateBulk in useCommentGenerator accepts an optional appendSymbol parameter
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-16 does not specify that the bulk comment generator should support an appendSymbol parameter. That parameter is specific to REQ-17 for AI Templates. The UserView does not pass a symbol to generateBulk, making this parameter unrequested for the bulk generation context.
